Child Falls to Death From 10th Floor Balcony in Delhi

A 4 or 5-year-old girl has died after falling from the 10th floor of a residential building in South Delhi. Police are investigating the incident. The building is identified as DDA Asha Kiran Apartments in Southeast Delhi.
